details: World stock markets are experiencing declines on November 25, 2026, as reports circulate about impending fresh US tariff threats. The Trump administration is expected to release findings from a probe into alleged excess industrial capacity among 16 major US trading partners, which could pave the way for new import duties. This prospect has led to a notable drop in Asian shares and a bearish outlook for US stock futures, particularly in the tech sector, reflecting a broader investor shift away from risk.
title: Global Stocks Fall on Looming US Tariffs

details: On November 23-25, 2026, the European Commission adopted its 22nd package of sanctions against Russia. Key measures include expanding transaction bans to approximately 60 Russian banks, intensifying efforts to crack down on crypto and payment networks used for sanctions evasion, and establishing an EU Crypto Sanctions Task Force. These sanctions aim to further limit Russia's ability to finance its war efforts in Ukraine.
title: EU Proposes New Russia Sanctions Targeting Crypto

details: The UK's energy regulator, Ofgem, announced on November 25, 2026, a 26% increase in the energy price cap for January 2027. This hike will raise the typical annual household energy bill to £2,166, an increase of £443 per year. The surge is primarily attributed to rising international gas prices, exacerbated by the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. This significant increase is expected to exacerbate inflationary pressures in the UK, potentially prompting the Bank of England to maintain or further tighten its monetary policy.
title: UK Energy Price Cap Jumps 26%, Fueling Inflation Concerns

details: Major cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, are experiencing declines on November 25, 2026, as a broader risk-off sentiment takes hold in global financial markets. This downturn is linked to factors such as renewed US tariff threats, persistent inflation concerns, and expectations of potential interest rate hikes. The crypto market has seen reduced demand and a wave of liquidations in leveraged positions, contributing to the ongoing sell-off.
title: Cryptocurrency Markets Decline Amid Broader Risk-Off Sentiment
